import numpy as np
def blocks(inp, stride, size, off=0):
    n=(7-size)//stride+1
    return [[np.array(inp)[r:r+size, c:c+size] for c in range(off, off+stride*n, stride)] for r in range(off, off+stride*n, stride)]

def get_filler(inp):
    cc=Counter(v for r in inp for v in r)
    return max((n,v) for v,n in cc.items() if v!=0)[1]

def feat(name, fn):
    feats[name]=fn
